notes: Evergreen places around Toowoomba. A maintainer can add or edit places here. type is the group heading on the full list. types lists every filter the place belongs to, and the first matching official page is url. Keep summaries short and do not invent events.

places.name: Queens Park and Botanic Gardens
places.summary: Heritage gardens and lawns beside the CBD, playgrounds and barbecues, and the ground for the Carnival of Flowers.

places.name: Spring Bluff railway station
places.summary: A heritage station and gardens about 15 minutes north of the city, along Murphy's Creek Road.

places.name: Drive to Pittsworth
places.summary: About 40 km southwest across farming country, with a historical village, gallery and a small main street.

places.name: Table Top Mountain walk
places.summary: A steep Grade 5 return walk to the flat summit. The route is not maintained, so wear boots and take care.

places.name: Redwood Park
places.summary: Escarpment bushland with walking tracks and a picnic area, reached from Bridge Street or the Range highway.

places.name: Jubilee Park
places.summary: A large bushland park below the escarpment, with walking trails and mountain-bike tracks.

places.name: Ravensbourne National Park
places.summary: Short rainforest and palm-creek walks, and Gus Beutel lookout over the range. Day visits only.

places.name: Toowoomba parkrun
places.summary: A free 5 km every Saturday morning on the paths through Queens Park. Register once with parkrun and bring a barcode.

places.name: Highfields parkrun
places.summary: A free Saturday 5 km at Highfields Sports and Recreation Park on Barracks Road.

places.name: Ju Raku En Japanese Garden
places.summary: A traditional Japanese stroll garden with a lake, bridges and paths, on the UniSQ Toowoomba campus.

places.name: Picnic Point lookout
places.summary: The escarpment lookout over the Lockyer Valley, with playgrounds, picnic lawns and short walks in the parklands.

places.name: Crows Nest Falls
places.summary: Cascades and a 20 metre waterfall in eucalypt forest, about 50 km north of Toowoomba. Stay behind the lookout barriers.

places.name: Laurel Bank Park
places.summary: Formal gardens, a scented garden, a playground and picnic lawns a short walk from the centre.
